name: gasoline_double_injection
title: Double gasoline injection (TP5 exercise 3)
summary: Teaching exercise: two gasoline injections per cylinder of a four-stroke engine. Start and end of each injection, the fuel-air ratio, the volumetric efficiency and the standard air conditions fix the injected masses and the fuel flows. The fuel is a mass.

origin.course: ULiège MCI, TP5, exercise 3 (double gasoline injection).

verification.summary: Compared with the EES stored solution of Ex_3_Deux injections moteur essence_PNG.EES (20 variables decoded by ees_extract.py). compare_solution.py: 20 common variables, 0 differ (rtol=0.001); only in EES: 0; only in CoolSolve: 6. Largest relative difference 3.24e-04 on rho_a and M_dot_a (CoolProp vs EES density of Air at 25 °C, 101325 Pa).

verification.notes: No common variable exceeds rtol 0.001. rho_a is DENSITY(Air, T=25 °C, P=101325 Pa); the 3.24e-04 gap is CoolProp versus EES, and M_dot_a carries the same ratio. f = 1/28 differs from the stored decimal by 1.20e-10; DELTAt_1, DELTAt_2 and DELTAt_tot differ by 1.20e-10, 1.90e-10 and 5.00e-11. The six names only in CoolSolve are M_dot_f, m_tot, m_1, m_2, M_dot_1 and M_dot_2; they are not in the stored solution. The same equations applied to the stored M_dot_a give values 3.24e-04 lower. No enthalpy is computed, so the ideal-gas Air enthalpy offset does not appear. Unit system already SI MASS DEG PA C J; p1 is stored in Pa; comparison without --ees-units. With and without initials: 4 iterations, identical solution. All 26 equations satisfied.
